content: Circle: Spaces (post/chat/course/event types, one type per space), member directory with filters/custom fields, one-click RSVP with reminders and calendars, weekly digest, in-app + email + push notification matrix (rows: comments on my posts, replies, mentions, likes, DMs; per-space new-post toggles), scheduled posts/drafts, pinned post block, invitation/signup links that auto-apply tags/access groups, welcome banner + default landing page, community analytics (engagement rate, posts/comments per member, top members/content, date ranges) on all plans, member Report via three-dots menu, block applies to DMs only, moderators can delete/remove/ban.
